items.group: Language and toolchain
items.name: Go
items.role: The language the core is written in. go.mod requires at least this version, and the sandbox and CI build with exactly it.

items.group: Language and toolchain
items.name: Go (installed in this sandbox)
items.role: What this sandbox builds and tests with (the toolchain go.mod asks for, downloaded automatically).

items.group: Language and toolchain
items.name: Node.js (installed in this sandbox)
items.role: Builds the UI and runs its tests (remix test and the Remix CLI need Node 24.3 or newer) and the browser tests. Agent CLIs installed through npm also need it (decision D9: Node 22+ on the user's machine).
items.note: Newest Node release overall: 26.11.1. The project stays on 22 (decision D9); the latest 22.x is the comparison.

items.group: Language and toolchain
items.name: npm (installed in this sandbox)
items.role: Installs the UI packages.
items.hold: Comes with Node; it moves when Node does.
items.note: Ships with Node; the version that comes with Node 22 is the one that matters.

items.group: Tools Drydock runs or you install
items.name: GitHub CLI (gh)
items.role: The GitHub CLI Drydock uses for pull requests and for the GitHub integration (repository issues, the signed-in account); you install it and Drydock never stores a GitHub token.
items.note: Version shown is what the documentation says the project was written against. The sandbox has gh 2.89.0.

items.group: Tools Drydock runs or you install
items.name: go-task
items.role: Runs Taskfile targets (build, test, lint); optional, not bundled.

items.group: Tools Drydock runs or you install
items.name: osv-scanner
items.role: The dependency vulnerability check (sends package names to osv.dev unless run offline); you install it.

items.group: Tools Drydock runs or you install
items.name: go-licenses
items.role: Produces THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

items.group: Tools Drydock runs or you install
items.name: govulncheck
items.role: Go's own vulnerability scanner; used by the audit tool, runs with go run at its newest version.
items.note: Not pinned: the audit runs it at @latest each time.

items.group: Tools Drydock runs or you install
items.name: golangci-lint (CI lint job)
items.role: The Go linter the CI lint job runs (go install ...@v2.14.0 in .github/workflows/ci.yml) with the committed .golangci.yml, for the Windows and the Linux build (audit F22). Keep the version here and in ci.yml the same.

items.group: Tools Drydock runs or you install
items.name: Wrangler
items.role: Cloudflare's CLI. The documentation lists it as an external verification tool for projects that deploy to Cloudflare; Drydock does not bundle or call it.

items.group: Tools Drydock runs or you install
items.name: Docker-compatible container engine (docker)
items.role: The container engine of the per-task sandbox (decision P30, docs/sandbox.md): Docker Desktop or another Docker-compatible engine you install; Drydock runs only the docker command and never bundles an engine. The egress proxy image it starts is built from this repository (cmd/drydock-egress) and imported locally, not pulled.
items.note: Version shown is the Docker Engine and CLI the sandbox was tested with on Linux. Drydock uses only long-standing docker commands (network create --internal, import, run, exec, inspect), so any current release should work; Docker Desktop on Windows is unverified.
